_comment: Curated root causes for scripts/lobsters-specs. Failures are clustered
mechanically by exception message; this file is what turns a cluster into
a named todo with an owner. Rules are tried in order; first match wins.
Occurrences churn — 314 failures is a shadow. Causes are the worklist, so
they carry stable slugs you can still discuss forty upstream commits later.
compiler — roundhouse modeling debt. Ours to fix.
app      — a lobsters idiom that could change upstream. Only ever a
plain-Rails change that stands on its own merits under stock
Rails; the port never asks for app-side divergence.
gem      — a gem whose surface we shim.
harness  — this harness's own gap, not the emit's.
A rule matches on `match` (exception message) or `match_class` (exception
class). Anything unmatched lands in the `unclassified` bucket, whose size
is itself a todo (triage it, then add a rule). A rule matching zero
failures is reported too: the cause may be cleared, or its message moved.

causes.title: Keystore.upsert unimplemented
causes.note: Needs Rails upsert with on_duplicate:/returning: and `self.primary_key = "key"` honored. Keystore.increment_value_for sits under Story#mark_submitter, so it fires on nearly every model that saves a story.

causes.title: SearchParser emits an empty class — parslet's class-body DSL is dropped
causes.note: parslet `rule(...)` calls in a class body are silently dropped though main.rb requires the gem, so SearchParser emits as a 2-line empty class. Needs verbatim class-body passthrough for non-AR classes on the ruby family, and a warning either way.

causes.title: Symbol used where an Integer index is expected
causes.match: no implicit conversion of Symbol into Integer
causes.note: Undiagnosed. Shape suggests a Hash emitted as an Array (or a symbol-keyed read lowered to an index) — needs a reduction before it can be ranked honestly.

causes.title: saved_change_to_<col>? not synthesized
causes.note: The ActiveModel::Dirty subset synthesizes <col>_previously_changed? but not the saved_change_to_<col>? spelling of the same question.

causes.title: nil reaching integer arithmetic
causes.match: nil can't be coerced into Integer
causes.note: A nullable read flows into arithmetic without narrowing. Sibling of the nullable-column arc that closed across all targets on 07-25 — this is the arithmetic seam that arc did not cover.

causes.title: Kernel#BigDecimal not available on models
causes.note: Kernel-level conversion function called from model bodies; the runtime exposes no BigDecimal.

causes.title: Rails::AppPath#+ unimplemented
causes.match: undefined method [`']\+' for an instance of Rails::AppPath
causes.note: Rails.root is modeled as an AppPath value class that supports join but not +.

causes.title: errors is an Array, not an ActiveModel::Errors
causes.match: undefined method [`'](messages|full_messages|add|\[\])' for an instance of Array
causes.note: The runtime errors collection is Array[String]; attribute identity is lost at push, so errors[:attr] and errors.messages have nothing to answer with.

causes.title: Model.first unimplemented as a class method
causes.note: Relation#first exists; the class-level shorthand does not forward to it. Related to the scalar-class-method forwarding gap.

causes.title: Nested constant not emitted
causes.note: Constants nested inside a model class (Hat::Mail, Notification::Notifiable) are dropped rather than emitted alongside the class.

causes.title: Relation#pick unimplemented
causes.match: undefined method [`']pick' for an instance of ActiveRecord::Relation
causes.note: pick returns a single value rather than an Array; a previous fix covered the call sites that lower to SQL, not the runtime Relation.

causes.title: travel_to unavailable to specs
causes.note: ActiveSupport::Testing::TimeHelpers is a spec-side helper stock Rails mixes into example groups. Ours to provide in the shim, not compiler debt.

causes.title: Ran, answered wrong
causes.note: No exception — the emitted code executed and produced a different answer than Rails does. Each needs individual diagnosis; they cluster by message no better than by coin flip, so this bucket is a count, not a cause. Keep it visible: it is where correctness bugs hide once the crash-shaped failures clear.
